body.faq_description: Common questions about ecommerce development in the UAE, platforms, local payments and timelines.

faqs.question: What ecommerce platforms do you build for UAE retailers?
faqs.answer: We work with Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce and custom headless storefronts using Next.js. Platform choice depends on your catalogue size, UAE payment needs and growth plans.

faqs.question: Can you integrate UAE payment gateways?
faqs.answer: Yes. We integrate Tabby, Telr, Stripe, Apple Pay and other gateways required for UAE checkout. Flows are tested on mobile devices before launch.

faqs.question: Do you build multilingual stores?
faqs.answer: Yes. We build multilingual storefronts with localised product content, RTL layouts for Arabic and SEO-friendly URL structures for UAE and GCC audiences.

faqs.question: Do you support cash on delivery?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can scope checkout flows that support COD and local delivery rules common in the UAE ecommerce market.

faqs.question: How long does UAE ecommerce development take?
faqs.answer: A focused Shopify or WooCommerce store often takes 3-6 weeks depending on catalogue size and integrations. Headless builds typically take 6-10 weeks. We provide a realistic timeline after discovery.

faqs.question: Can you migrate my existing UAE online store?
faqs.answer: Yes. We migrate stores to modern platforms or headless architectures with URL redirects and SEO preservation where possible.

faqs.question: Do you also build ecommerce for global markets?
faqs.answer: Yes. IGENTX delivers ecommerce worldwide as well as in the UAE. See our global ecommerce development page for international projects.

faqs.question: Do you provide maintenance after launch?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer ongoing support covering security updates, catalogue changes, performance monitoring and conversion improvements.
